title: Desk Reference: Provider Change, Void and Open-Request Settings in Prior Authorization
content:
**Quick reference.** For each Prior Authorization class, Prairie Ridge Health Plan sets whether the servicing provider may be changed on an approved authorization, whether a new servicing provider must be in network, the most open authorizations a member may hold for the same service code over overlapping dates, and whether voiding an approval releases its unused units.

| Class | Servicing provider may be changed on an approval | New servicing provider must be in network | Most open authorizations, same service code and overlapping dates | Void releases unused units |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Advanced Imaging Authorization | Yes | Yes | 1 | Yes |
| Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization | Yes | Yes | 1 | Yes |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | Yes | Yes | 1 | Yes |
| Home Health Services Authorization | Yes | Yes | 1 | Yes |
| Behavioral Health Intensive Services Authorization | Yes | Yes | 1 | Yes |
| Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization | No | Yes | 1 | Yes |
| Out-of-Network Services Authorization | No | Yes | 1 | Yes |

**At a glance.**

- Classes that allow a change of servicing provider on an approval: Advanced Imaging Authorization, Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization, Durable Medical Equipment Authorization, Home Health Services Authorization and Behavioral Health Intensive Services Authorization.
- Classes that do not: Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization and Out-of-Network Services Authorization.
- In every class a new servicing provider must be in network, a member holds at most 1 open authorization for the same service code over overlapping dates, and a void releases the approval's unused units.
